Can you explain the main options in simple terms?

02:58 PM

Of course. If you are just getting started, here are the main denim fit options in simple terms 😊

Skinny: fitted closely from waist to ankle for a sleek look.
Straight: falls straight through the leg for an easy everyday fit.
Bootcut: fitted through the thigh with a slight flare at the ankle, great with boots or heels.
Flare: fitted up top with a wider flare from the knee down for a more dressed-up look.
Wide-leg: roomy through the leg for a relaxed, comfort-first style.
Boyfriend or relaxed: looser through the hips and legs for a casual feel.

Some common styles are:
Mia Slim Fit Skinny for a sleek fitted look.
Connie High-Rise Skinny for a high-rise, leg-lengthening fit.
Catherine Boyfriend for a relaxed casual fit.
Diana Relaxed Straight for everyday comfort.
Ana Bootcut for balance and easy styling with boots.
Stella High-Rise Flare for a more fashion-forward shape.
Fab Ab Wide Leg for a relaxed wide-leg feel.

You can also use the fit guide here: https://www.kutfromthekloth.com/pages/denim-fit-guide
And the fit quiz here: https://www.kutfromthekloth.com/pages/fit-quiz
